about: The antechamber (docs/milestones/crypt-rework.md, CR3): a floating slab of the crypt's flagstones hanging in the dark, its edge a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall (its void a wall), two bays where the slab runs out, the floor pushed out round every spawn, gate, pillar and decal. Off-centre north and south sockets (the owner, 2026-11-20: doorways anywhere along an edge where the layout makes sense). tools/ground_shape.py draws arena_01_ground.tscn and its art from this.
